items.title: Abe Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: I went with Les Brown at the end of 19, almost 20... I made 'Mexican Hat Dance,' it was my first recording with Les... Doris Day was on the band, the first band I was on with Les.

ctx.x: Well then about — between 18 and 19. By then I was experienced. Boy I was really— 18 I think, because I went with Les Brown at the end of 19, almost 20, because I made “Mexican Hat Dance,” it was my first recording with Les, a big recording. I was almost 20. I think I was 19, 19-1/2 So this must have been the year before I joined Les so it’s got to be, I must have been almost 18.
52nd Street must have been a marvelous place to be.
